_comment: Golden questions for sample_files/mongodb.pdf (The Little MongoDB Book, 36 pages).
expected_pages holds the 0-indexed PDF pages that actually answer the question,
matching the `page` metadata PyPDFLoader puts on every chunk.
An empty expected_pages marks an off-topic control: the corpus cannot answer it,
so retrieving nothing is the correct outcome and is scored as abstention.
Regenerate expected_pages if the source PDF is ever replaced.
